title: Microphone Protection
description: Reversible protection for detected ALSA capture devices. Requires verified LG voice blocking for remote audio coverage.
disableDescription: Removes this module's microphone-device blocks so those capture devices can work again. The saved preference is kept for later re-enabling. LG voice-service blocking is controlled separately in Privacy Protection.
publisher: Unknown Digital and Unknown Suite contributors
permissions: Runs as root; declarations are not a sandbox
Overlays detected ALSA capture nodes only after checking they are closed; restores only owned overlays
Reads capture and process metadata; never records microphone audio

status.title: View current status
status.description: Lists detected capture devices, requested blocking, verified blocks and devices currently held open. A verified result covers only detected, supported paths.

health.title: Check module health
health.description: Checks requested capture blocks and the required LG voice-service block. Unsupported or busy devices are reported, not forcibly changed.

maintenance.title: Reapply saved settings
maintenance.description: Rechecks detected capture devices and reapplies the saved blocking choice where safe. If blocking is off, it removes any remaining overlays owned by this module.

setBlocking.title: Apply capture blocking

enabled.title: Requested microphone-device blocking
enabled.description: ON blocks supported detected capture inputs, including normal built-in and connected USB/camera audio paths. OFF restores this module's blocks. Proprietary drivers and early-boot or hotplug gaps are not guaranteed covered.

setBlocking.description: Changes access to detected microphone capture devices. LG voice-service protection must already be verified; active or unsupported devices are not forcibly blocked.
